chitchat: rubs out a price on the chalkboard with his thumb and writes a shorter one
"Kingfishers at home, I'd want a better price than that. But it's my price, so."
counts a fold of notes, twice, and puts it in a tin
"Pick a side, put your money down. Odds are on the board."
glances up at the screen over the bar, then back to his ledger
"House always wins. Not always tonight, mind. Over the month."
description: A narrow man at a chalkboard by the cashier's cage, sleeves held up with garters, a pencil behind each ear. The board lists the games on the air and his prices on them in a tidy hand. He takes bets on the sports. Type odds to see the board.

how.text: "Game comes on, I put a price on both sides. Type odds to read it. Punt fifty on the Rats at two-forty and if they win you get a hundred and twenty back. Book shuts once the game's going."

root.first: "New face. You want a bet, the board's right there."
